name: Lee Kee Holdings Limited
summary: Lee Kee Holdings Limited, a holding company founded in 1947 and located in Tai Po, Hong Kong, chiefly trades non-ferrous metals in Hong Kong and Mainland China. Its products include zinc, nickel, aluminum, stainless steel, electroplating chemicals and lead-free solder wires, and it supplies precious metal plating products like gold cyanide, silver anodes, palladium and rhodium solutions.
